subject: DPA signoff lane, technical fallbacks & Order Form signature alignment
messages:
From: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@prospecthealth.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@prospecthealth.com
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 09:12:00 +0200
Subject: ProspectHealth DPA redline and clarifications

Hi Grace / Laura,

Thanks again for the call this morning. Attached is our redline of the DPA that pairs with the MSA/Order Form. Key asks from legal are:
- ProspectHealth needs controller/processor language clarified for the analytics export path (we currently show ProspectHealth as controller).
- SCCs preference: client has a bespoke appendix; they want confirmation Redwood will accept SCCs with a Transfer Impact Addendum (TIA) to be added to the DPA.
- Subprocessor list: they asked for the current subprocessor inventory and KMS approach for customer-separated keys.

We also flagged that the Order Form references a dedicated "Private" hosting option for EU-only data; they'd like a signature path that makes the Order Form effective independent of the DPA (i.e., sign Order Form now, DPA to follow with a short amendment).

Can you confirm whether Redwood can: (1) accept SCCs + TIA, (2) provide a current subprocessor snapshot, and (3) allow Order Form signature to go first with a follow-on DPA amendment?

Attachment: (attachment: ProspectHealth_DPA_redline_v2.docx, type: docx)

Appreciate a quick reply — procurement would like to move to signature this week.

Best,
Marta
Legal Counsel | ProspectHealth

From: grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
To: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@prospecthealth.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 3 Aug 2026 11:05:00 +0200
Subject: Re: ProspectHealth DPA redline and clarifications

Marta — thanks for the redline. Quick answers and next steps below.

TL;DR: We can accept SCCs + TIA with a limited operational carve (see item 2), we can provide an exported subprocessor list and KMS summary, and we can sign the Order Form first if the DPA amendment path is contractually gated. We do need legal to confirm a final fallback for cross-border exports.

Notes:
1) SCCs + TIA: Redwood legal is open to adding the standard SCCs and a Transfer Impact Addendum. Our legal team will propose a short exhibit that documents hosting region constraints and reasonable mitigation commitments (e.g., written assessment + mitigation plan, not guarantees).

2) Controller/Processor: On analytics exports, ProspectHealth is controller and Redwood processor. However, if the Order Form enables a "Private (VPC)" deployment and ProspectHealth requests a separate on-prem connector, we need a clear callout in the DPA that processor obligations increase for that configuration (subprocessor approvals, data flow restrictions).

3) Subprocessor & KMS: Ben will pull the current subprocessor inventory and brief note on KMS/CMK options (we support customer-managed keys in Private + dedicated naming for Dedicated deployments). Expect the list by EOD tomorrow.

4) Order Form signature cadence: We can accept signing Order Form now with an MSA/DPA amendment to follow. Legal wants a one-paragraph exhibit in the Order Form that: (a) references the DPA as a governing exhibit, (b) mandates execution within X days, and (c) defines permitted fallback if DPA fails to execute (e.g., scope-limited hosting).

Action items:
- Ben C. to send subprocessor list and KMS note (ben_carter@redwood.ai) — due 2026-08-04 EOD.
- Karthik to lead the light-touch DPA exhibit for SCCs + TIA and draft the Order Form exhibit (karthik_iyer@redwood.ai) — draft by 2026-08-04 midday.
- Grace to confirm acceptable fallback language with product for Private/Dedicated hosting.

Grace
Grace O'Connor
Head of Sales Operations | Redwood Inference

From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@prospecthealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 4 Aug 2026 16:34:00 +0200
Subject: Subprocessor inventory + KMS note (ProspectHealth)

Hi Marta / team,

Per Grace's ask: attached is our current subprocessor snapshot (last updated 07-28-2026) and a short summary of KMS options. Highlights:
- Current subprocessors included: CloudInfraCo (compute), ObjStore Ltd (S3-compatible storage), MetricsPipelineInc (telemetry/metrics).
- For EU-only requirement: we can run Dedicated or Private with region pinning. For cryptographic separation, Private supports customer-managed keys (via our KMS integrations) — note: HSM-backed KMS is available under private deployments; hosted plans use Redwood-managed keys by default.
- Subprocessor list is high-level; we will provide SOC2 scope statements on request.

Attachment: (attachment: OrderForm_ProspectHealth_v1.pdf, type: pdf)

I'm linking the small KMS snippet here as the attachment and will provide export CSV if legal needs the full inventory.

Ben
Ben Carter
Senior Security & Privacy Program Manager | Redwood Inference

From: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
To: Marta Nowak <marta.nowak@prospecthealth.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, karthik_iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 5 Aug 2026 16:27:00 +0200
Subject: Final signoff path and DocuSign link (next steps)

Marta — thank you for the fast turnaround. Internal legal has reviewed and we have the following, which should be acceptable to ProspectHealth with the redline items reconciled:

1) SCCs + TIA: we will accept SCCs and add a Transfer Impact Addendum exhibit (drafters: Karthik and Redwood legal). The TIA will include a written assessment of transfer routes and a remediation plan if a material risk is identified — not an absolute warranty.

2) Order Form execution: Redwood agrees to an Order Form-first signature path provided the Order Form exhibits the DPA execution timeline (30 days) and a narrowly scoped fallback (service continues but EU-only hosting to be enforced when DPA fully executed).

3) Roles: we will keep ProspectHealth as controller and Redwood as processor. Any deviation (e.g., ProspectHealth-managed connector that requires additional processing) will be captured in an appendix and reviewed case-by-case.

4) Attachments & evidence: Ben will upload the full subprocessor CSV and SOC2 statement to the shared Drive link (we'll notify when available).

If ProspectHealth is aligned, please sign the Order Form via DocuSign (link below). We'll schedule a 30-minute triage call after signature to walk through the DPA exhibit we will deliver within 5 business days.

DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/en/link/abc123-sign
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890

Best,
Laura Bennett
VP, Legal Operations | Redwood Inference
